Knowing a teacher is not the same as being ready to learn.

Kevin Trudeau shares a line from the Bhagavad Gita. Krishna tells Arjuna that to learn from those who know the truth, you must do three things: humble yourself before them, question them, and serve them.

Only then, Krishna says, are you open to receive the truth. Kevin points out that readiness comes before the lesson.

Which of the three is hardest for you?

#ad #success #mindset #kevintrudeau

Be careful of anyone who thinks they are the end-all.

Kevin Trudeau says the more teachers give, the more they need to know how to receive from someone higher still. Students see the teacher as the big magnet, but the teacher knows of a bigger one to hold on to.

That is why he says your greatest teacher is someone who is always learning, not someone who thinks they know it all.

Who in your life is still learning?
